name: RegistryValidators
key_decisions: Validators are pure module-level functions on adventure.py (not Room methods)
assert_symmetric skips sealed edges and reports first asymmetric edge with offender + direction
assert_connected uses BFS over passage edges; missing rooms reported sorted
assert_symmetric is the authority on unknown room ids; assert_connected silently skips them
Validators invoked once inside run_game_loop (NOT at import time)
public_symbols: assert_connected(rooms: dict[str, Room], start: str) -> None
